svg.aria-label: The failure ledger: four claims that turned out wrong and what replaced them. TCMF version one scored 0.02 recall at 5 on the causal signal it was built for, where the causal signal alone reaches 1.00. AUGUR's forecasting programme was killed by its own phase zero. COLD READ's headline finding failed to replicate on a second model. The adk-python pull request was closed unmerged after an LGTM. Each correction is published in the write-up rather than dropped.

g.text: Four things I was wrong about, and where the correction is published. Struck, not deleted.
TCMF will retrieve on causal precedence, not just similarity.
v1 scored 0.02 where the oracle scores 1.00. Multiplicative fusion was the bug; additive fixed it.
Time-locked models will forecast their own future better than we assume.
Phase 0 killed the programme. The 1938 model thinks it is 1899, which is the better finding.
Short samples read below chance: ignorance looks like confident wrongness.
It did not replicate on a second model. The correction is published; the headline is not.
adk-python #6190 will land. It passed a full review round and got an LGTM.
Closed unmerged, superseded by a maintainer's own fix. Still on the record instead of edited out.
A method that was never wrong was never tested. Every correction above is in the write-up it belongs to.
